title: Congruence of compiled transitions
statement: Let $P$ and $P'$ be register programs with the same call specification at every state, and let $D$ be a fixed multi-tape machine and $q_0$ a fixed map of initial decider states. For any compiled control state $q$, if the ordinary transition functions of $P$ and $P'$ agree at every state $s$ for which $q$ is the program-running state at $s$, then the compiled one-step actions defined by $P$ and $P'$ agree at $q$.
hypotheses_covered: Ordinary transitions agree at every $s$ with $q=\mathrm{prog}(s)$
